books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch48 already makes draft residency a first-class edge cost, but it does not account for MoE target-expert union expansion during block verification. Add expansion-aware proposal/prefetch while retaining exact verifier ownership.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: DraftExpert targets expert-offloaded MoE where target verification activates the union of experts across a proposed block. It trains one accelerator-resident draft expert per layer from frozen-target residual/logit/router signals, then chooses block truncation by confidence and expansion cost while prefetching predicted target experts. Target verification still commits final tokens.
books_comparison.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: self-speculation optimized for acceptance -> include target-expert expansion/residency cost -> fixed-footprint draft expert + expansion-aware truncation -> exact target verification and token/KV commit.

books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch72 treats availability and abuse broadly but lacks the case where service remains responsive while a deadline-gated slow path loses semantic authority. Add deadline-induced accuracy collapse and hand queue/admission mechanisms to Ch56.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: A two-tier inference pipeline accepts timely fast-path predictions and conditionally merges a more accurate remote slow path before a deadline. Shaped bursts congest shared slow-path resources so benign results arrive after the merger cutoff; service remains available, but semantic accuracy collapses because the slow evidence is discarded.
books_comparison.evolution_relation: Layering / Dependency: latency deadline as SLO -> deadline as merge/commit boundary -> shaped contention suppresses high-accuracy evidence -> availability protection must include semantic-quality residual risk.
books_comparison.evidence_boundary: Supports a network-driven accuracy-collapse attack surface in deadline-gated multi-tier inference. It does not prove all jitter is adversarial, all late-result discard causes equivalent semantic loss, or that the proposed workload transfers unchanged to other pipelines.
books_comparison.proposed_section: 分布式 inference 的 availability 不能只问 endpoint 是否返回。Fast/slow-path pipeline 若在 deadline 前合并远端高质量结果，deadline 同时就是 semantic commit boundary：攻击者无需访问权重或 victim data，只要用 shaped burst 推迟 slow path，merger 便会丢弃本应提高准确率的证据，系统仍及时响应却发生 accuracy collapse。防御因此要把 per-tenant isolation、queue/admission、late-result policy 与最终质量一起监控；延长 deadline 会损害 SLO，强隔离会牺牲利用率。单一 tracking pipeline 的作者实验只证明该 attack surface 可存在，不证明所有网络抖动或 tiered system 都会同样退化。

books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch56 covers calibrated routing models and model/placement choice but not a finite-sample risk contract for model-tier commit/defer. Add conformal set-size routing and explicitly hand calibration/evaluator identity to Ch66.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Each model tier uses repeated black-box samples to form a frequency-based nonconformity score, calibrated on held-out labeled queries. The scheduler commits only when the conformal prediction set is sufficiently small and otherwise defers to the next tier, connecting a user-specified error level to expected cascade cost.
books_comparison.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: raw confidence threshold -> held-out conformal calibration -> prediction-set commit/defer -> multi-tier risk/cost scheduling with explicit assumptions and fallback.
books_comparison.evidence_boundary: Supports conformal set-size routing and finite-sample marginal coverage under the stated assumptions. It does not provide unconditional correctness for open-ended generation, adversarial/domain drift or arbitrary adaptive selection.
books_comparison.proposed_section: 多层模型 cascade 的 routing 可以从经验 confidence threshold 演进为带假设的 risk contract。每个 tier 用 held-out calibration 把 response frequency/logprob 转成 conformal prediction set；只有集合足够小才 commit，否则升级到更强模型。这样把误差预算与预计 cascade cost 放进同一调度状态，却不等于获得无条件置信度：finite-sample coverage 依赖 exchangeability，更紧的 cascade-level bound 还依赖 selection-preservation；open-ended output 需要额外 answer clustering。重复采样、标注 calibration 与 drift monitoring 都是成本。Domain 漂移、严格 latency 或缺少标签时，保守阈值/直接大模型仍是可成立分支。
